title: HLC logical counter overflow at u32::MAX
description: hlc.rs:36: self.last.logical + 1 with no overflow check. If wall_ms is unchanged and logical == u32::MAX, panics in debug; wraps to 0 in release. Wrapping breaks causality ordering. Same risk in receive() lines 52, 56 via .max(...) + 1. Fix: return Err on overflow or force wall_ms to advance. Trigger: node generating >4B events within a single millisecond, or mocked clock in tests.
